record.paper_title: Selected Conjectures and Open Problems on Directed Graphs
record.original_question: Is there a universal positive real constant c < 1 such that every sink-free digraph of order n has a quasi-kernel Q with |Q| <= c n?

evidence.quote: Problem 6.1 [34] Is there a positive real c < 1 such that for every sink-free digraph of order n, there exists a quasi-kernel Q with |Q| ≤ cn?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D=(V,A)$ be a finite digraph (no loops, no multiple arcs). A vertex $v\in V$ is called a sink if it has no out-neighbors; $D$ is sink-free if it contains no sinks. A subset $Q\subseteq V$ is independent if no arc of $D$ has both endpoints in $Q$. A quasi-kernel of $D$ is an independent set $Q\subseteq V$ such that for every vertex $v\in V\setminus Q$ there is a directed path of length 1 or 2 from $v$ to some vertex of $Q$. It is known (Chvátal–Lovász) that every digraph has a quasi-kernel.

Question: Does there exist an absolute constant $c\in(0,1)$ such that every sink-free digraph $D$ of order $n$ admits a quasi-kernel $Q$ with $|Q|\le cn$?
artifact.status_search_result: A 2024 survey on the small quasi-kernel conjecture explicitly states that it has not been proved that there exists some constant c < 1 such that every sink-free digraph G contains a quasi-kernel of size at most c|V(G)|. Various partial results are known for special classes (split digraphs, one-way split digraphs, orientations of certain graphs), but the general constant-factor question remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the Small Quasi-kernel conjecture — a survey
status_evidence.snippet: it has not even been proved that there exists some constant c<1 such that every digraph G with no sources contains a Qk with at most c|V(G)| vertices
status_evidence.claim: The weakened question of a constant c<1 is explicitly stated as unresolved in this survey.

status_evidence.title: Results on the Small Quasi-Kernel Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on partial progress toward the Erdős–Székely small quasi-kernel conjecture for special classes of digraphs.
status_evidence.claim: Only special-case progress is reported; no general linear bound cn with c<1.
